parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with saving content types to the correct database but lacks comprehensive testing and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the content type is saved to the correct database. This increases the risk of regressions in future changes.
The PR does not update any documentation to reflect the change. This could lead to confusion for developers who are not aware of the new behavior.
